events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez. Born March 14th, 1968. I ran out of lisinopril this morning. Can you just approve the refill right now so I can pick it up today?
Thanks, one moment while I check.

I can’t approve it, but I can send a request to the prescribing team for review. I can send a request about this recorded medication, lisinopril ten milligram tablets, one tablet once a day, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Yes. Send it. So it's approved , right? I can go to the pharmacy this afternoon.
Your request reference is R Q, two three one five, and it is awaiting prescribing team review. It is not approved or ready yet; the team will review it and contact you with the outcome.
